import itertools
from pysat.solvers import Glucose3

edges = [(i, j) for i in range(8) for j in range(i+1, 8)]
edge_to_var = {e: idx + 1 for idx, e in enumerate(edges)}

clauses = []

# No blue K3: for every triple, at least one edge not blue (i.e., not all positive)
for comb in itertools.combinations(range(8), 3):
    pairs = list(itertools.combinations(comb, 2))
    vars_list = [edge_to_var[(min(p), max(p))] for p in pairs]
    clauses.append([-v for v in vars_list])

# No red K4: for every quadruple, at least one edge blue (at least one positive var)
for comb in itertools.combinations(range(8), 4):
    pairs = list(itertools.combinations(comb, 2))
    vars_list = [edge_to_var[(min(p), max(p))] for p in pairs]
    clauses.append(vars_list)

solver = Glucose3()
for c in clauses:
    solver.add_clause(c)

satisfiable = solver.solve()
print(satisfiable)
if satisfiable:
    model = solver.get_model()
    assignment = {abs(x): x > 0 for x in model}
    colors = [1 if assignment[v] else 0 for v in range(1, 29)]
    print(colors)
